description: This file provides positioning extensions and resize handling for Drupal dialogs, including functions to reset dialog position and size on window events, and event listeners for dialog creation and closure.

methods.name: resetPosition
methods.description: Calculates and sets the dialog's position to be centered within displace.offsets boundaries.

methods.name: resetSize
methods.description: Adjusts dialog size and position on window resize or scroll, converting percentage heights to pixels and re-centering dialogs.
